A mention of the references Mortici (2011b, 2013b) was removed because the results contained therein are weaker than (5.6.1).
Addition (effective with 1.0.10):

Addition (effective with 1.0.7):
The reference to Mortici (2011b) has been added at the end of this subsection.
Addition (effective with 1.0.5):
References to Alzer (2008), Qi (2008), and Koumandos and Lamprecht (2010) have been added at the end of this subsection. Also, (5.6.5) has been identified as Kershaw’s Inequality.
